summary: Add a track to the user's favorites (preferred tracks)
description: Adds the specified track to the authenticated user's "preferite" (favorites) list. If the track does not exist, no error is returned but the track will not appear in any read request. Requires a valid client_id and an access_token with the 'music' scope.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, includes the absolute number of rows the query would return without limit/offset. May impact performance.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: A valid OAuth2 access token with 'music' scope for the user to be updated

parameters.name: track_id
parameters.description: The ID of the track to add to the user's favorites

notes: If the specified track_id does not exist, the request succeeds silently but the track will not be added.
The 'fullcount' parameter can degrade performance and is not available on all heavy methods.
